scope: Static inspection of bundled managed assembly metadata and IL. The inspected telemetry/helper methods were not invoked as tests. No model, main.py, verifier, database transaction, or network request was executed for this inspection.
inspection_method: System.Reflection.Metadata PEReader over File.OpenRead; inspect TypeDefinition/MethodDefinition and decoded IL. No Assembly.Load of the target assembly file or invocation of the inspected telemetry/helper methods.

environment.name: POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT
environment.must_be_set: Before starting the new pwsh process. Also set in the host process before launching codex so subprocess startup inherits it. Setting it only inside the later -Command body is too late to guarantee startup opt-out.

observations.meaning: The environment value is read during static initialization with default false. A true opt-out value sets CanSendTelemetry false and returns before the subsequent telemetry initialization body.
A single-character environment value 1 is explicitly accepted as true. Other accepted values were not needed for this recommendation.

limits: Bundled text/documentation search found no local explanation of this variable; the evidence is the installed implementation IL.
This proves the installed PowerShell implementation supports this opt-out. It is not an execution test that the retry has zero telemetry attempts.
Opt-out applies to PowerShell telemetry; it is not evidence that every unrelated component or SDK telemetry source is disabled.
No need to allow dc.services.visualstudio.com; retain the existing network restrictions.
If shell environment include filters are configured, they must retain this injected variable; environment configuration does not make a variable immutable.
